headword: {観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}

definitions.gloss: sightseeing spot; tourist attraction; famous place
definitions.explanation: A well-known place that attracts visitors and tourists, such as temples, shrines, natural scenery, historic sites, or other landmarks.

examples.japanese: {観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧。
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
examples.english: Although this town is small, it has many historic tourist attractions and bustles with visitors on weekends.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧ (sightseeing) and ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧ (famous place). Very commonly used in travel guides, tourism websites, and everyday conversation about travel destinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (to visit various sightseeing spots)
- {観光名所|かんこうめいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧ (to visit a tourist attraction)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{観光名所|かんこうめいしょ} (popular tourist attraction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧: famous place — broader meaning, not necessarily related to tourism
- ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧: tourist area — refers to the broader area or region, not a specific spot
